mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% in a quarter signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% in a quarter.
